changes: Separate UI bootstrap, application state, timeline, selected moment and setup dialog.
Separate vision transport/cache from search ranking/orchestration; remove redundant cache state.
Centralize shared input limits and capture, sheet, vision, search and chat settings without changing defaults or paid cache keys.
Display configured Twitch callback URL in setup.
Consolidate mock provider response setup; retain 30 distinct regression checks.
Remove unused imports and enable TypeScript unused-local and unused-parameter checks.
Refresh the completed recording view without allowing late responses to overwrite a new session.
Clamp search-derived clip titles to the shared API limit; share Twitch fallback title and UI chat score weight.

uiMarkup.method: Normalized React server-render comparisons with baseline; effects and event handlers do not execute.

validation.independentReview: Astra reviewed extraction, cache ownership and settings; final adversarial pass found two UI defects, now fixed and checked. No other material defect or disposable historical evidence found.

limitations: No interactive browser validation was available.
Exact equivalence covers the stated fixtures, not arbitrary inputs.
